description: Protected fragments adapted from a publicly shared pizza recipe

fragments.text: Mix 500 grams of bread flour with 325 milliliters of warm water
Add 7 grams of dry yeast and 10 grams of fine salt
Knead the dough for 10 minutes, then let it rise for 90 minutes
Preheat the oven to 250 degrees Celsius
Bake the pizza for 10 to 12 minutes
